title: Melisandre burns the Seven
description: On the beach of Dragonstone, the red priestess Melisandre burns the statues of the Seven and proclaims Stannis Baratheon the reborn Azor Ahai. Maester Cressen dies trying to poison her.

title: Massacre of Robert's bastards
description: On Joffrey's orders the City Watch butchers King Robert's bastard children in the streets of King's Landing. Only Gendry, already on the road north, escapes.

title: The red comet
description: A blood-red comet burns across the sky from Winterfell to the Red Waste. Wildfire, they call it; Lannister crimson; dragons. Old Nan knows: dragons.

title: Theon returns to Pyke
description: Theon Greyjoy sails home to broker an alliance for Robb — and finds a father who mocks his Stark upbringing and a sister, Yara, who has already taken his place. Balon means to take the North for himself.

title: The King of Highgarden's hundred thousand
description: Catelyn treats with Renly Baratheon in his sprawling war camp in the Stormlands, where knights joust while the real war burns. Brienne of Tarth defeats Loras and joins Renly's Kingsguard.
episodeTitle: What Is Dead May Never Die

title: Ambush on the kingsroad
description: Ser Amory Lorch's men fall on the Night's Watch recruits bound for the Wall. Yoren dies fighting; Arya, Gendry and Hot Pie are marched to Harrenhal as prisoners.
episodeTitle: What Is Dead May Never Die

title: Battle of Oxcross
description: Robb Stark's host, guided by Grey Wind, falls on a sleeping Lannister camp in the Westerlands and shatters it — one of the young wolf's cleanest victories.

title: The shadow beneath Storm's End
description: Refused by Renly, Stannis sends Davos to smuggle Melisandre ashore beneath Storm's End — where she births a thing of living shadow.

title: Daenerys at the gates of Qarth
description: Starving out of the Red Waste, Daenerys and her ragged khalasar are admitted to the greatest city that ever was or will be — on Xaro Xhoan Daxos's blood oath.

title: The shadow kills Renly
description: Melisandre's shadow-thing passes through Renly Baratheon's tent and runs him through before Catelyn and Brienne's eyes. Brienne is blamed, and flees sworn to vengeance.

title: A man pays his debts
description: Jaqen H'ghar owes the girl three lives for the three she saved from the fire. Arya names the Tickler — and Harrenhal's torturer is found with his neck broken.

title: Theon seizes Winterfell
description: With Robb's host away south, Theon Greyjoy storms his foster home with a handful of ironborn and executes Ser Rodrik Cassel on its steps. Bran and Rickon vanish into the night.
episodeTitle: The Old Gods and the New

title: The bread riot
description: A starving mob turns on Joffrey's procession, tearing the High Septon apart and nearly dragging Sansa from her horse before the Hound cuts her free.
episodeTitle: The Old Gods and the New

title: The dragons are stolen
description: Returning from the Spice King, Daenerys finds her Dothraki slaughtered and her three dragons gone — carried in chains to the House of the Undying.
episodeTitle: The Old Gods and the New

title: The farm boys
description: Bran and Rickon's trail goes cold — so Theon burns two farm boys and hangs their tarred bodies from Winterfell's gates as the Stark princes. The North will never forgive it.

title: Jon and Ygritte
description: On a ranging in the Skirling Pass, Jon Snow cannot bring himself to execute the wildling Ygritte. She leads him in circles until it is Jon who is the captive.

title: Hiding beneath the hunters' feet
description: Bran, Rickon, Osha and Hodor double back and hide in Winterfell's own crypts while Theon hunts them across the countryside.

title: Battle of the Blackwater
description: Stannis Baratheon's fleet sails into a trap of wildfire that turns Blackwater Bay green with flame. Tyrion leads the sortie that holds the walls until Tywin and the Tyrells break the siege.

title: The Hound quits the field
description: Wildfire breaks something in Sandor Clegane. He walks out of the battle, tells the king to burn, and offers to take Sansa north — she refuses.

title: Winterfell burned
description: The ironborn hand Theon over and Ramsay's men put Winterfell to the torch. Dying beneath the heart tree, Maester Luwin sends Bran and Rickon north to the Wall.

title: The House of the Undying
description: Daenerys walks the warlocks' tower of visions — a ruined throne room under snow, the Wall, Drogo and her son — then burns Pyat Pree alive with three words: dracarys.

title: Valar morghulis
description: Jaqen H'ghar gives Arya an iron coin and the words to redeem it in Braavos, then changes his face before her eyes and is gone.

title: The dead march on the Fist
description: Three horn blasts scatter the Night's Watch at the Fist of the First Men. Sam, left behind in the storm, watches an army of wights pass — led by a White Walker on a dead horse.
